title: How to make sprite s of any size and have them work in your game (IMAGES INCLUDED)

posts.author: gabbysogabby
posts.body:
idk how many guides there are about this but here i go about doing it
im using asprite but it should work with any image editing software
YOU MUST ADD A $ AT THE START OF THE PNG NAME OR ELSE THIS WONT WORK
step 1: make a sprite (this one is 158x187)
step 2: make a box the size of the canvas
step 3: copy & paste the box gird as shown below
(i usually leave a a two pixel wide gap here)
step 4: remove the grid and add to your game (you should be done now)
watch it move in game
if im having trouble lining something up making a simple ruler like this would solve it
when i was starting out rpg maker trying to make custom big sprites always gives me a headache
i hope i explained it the best i could and hope this will be useful to at least one or two people
